context: This criteria evaluates correct usage of the useAddItem mutation hook from @vercel/commerce-commercejs for adding products to the shopping cart. It assesses proper hook invocation, correct argument passing (productId, variantId, quantity), and SWR cache mutation after the operation.

checklist.name: useAddItem hook import
checklist.description: The useAddItem hook is imported from @vercel/commerce-commercejs cart module and properly initialized

checklist.name: productId argument
checklist.description: The mutation is called with the correct productId from the component's props

checklist.name: variantId argument
checklist.description: When a variantId prop is provided, it is passed to the mutation call; when absent, it is omitted or undefined

checklist.name: Default quantity
checklist.description: When quantity is not specified, the mutation relies on the hook's default (quantity of 1) rather than hardcoding or calculating a value

checklist.name: Async handling
checklist.description: The mutation call is awaited or handled as a promise, and any loading or error state is managed appropriately
